versions.changelog:
- Made the skill user-invocable.
- Updated the description metadata.
- Reorganized content for improved clarity, focusing on usage and SDKs.
- Added a new concise section summarizing how proxying works.

- The CLI installation instructions and metadata now reference the latest Keychains version (`keychains@latest`) instead of a fixed version.
- No code or functionality changes; documentation update only to always use the up-to-date Keychains CLI.

Keychains skill v1.0.0 – Secure, user-approved API calls without agent access to credentials.

- Initial release supporting credential-injecting API proxy for secure agent interactions.
- Works with curl, TypeScript, and Python agents using placeholder variables for real tokens.
- Requires no API key exposure; approvals handled by users via keychains.dev.
- Compatible with thousands of major API providers.
- Local credentials remain isolated from agents at all times.
- Comprehensive security, audit logging, and user control.
